newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta Jan-Feb exports down, imports up.
newsitem.headline: Malta Jan-Feb exports down, imports up.

text.p: Exports by Malta dropped by 3.2 million Malta pounds ($8.32 million) to 98.3 million pounds in the first two months of the year compared to the same period in 1996, the Central Office of Statistics said on Wednesday.
Imports rose by 5.5 million pounds to 156.6 million pounds during the same period.
The office said a drop in exports by the machinery and transport equipment sector caused a decline in domestic exports in the two months.

Imports of consumer goods and industrial supplies rose by 4.0 million pounds and 7.2 million pounds respecitvely but capital goods imports fell by 5.7 million pounds compared to the first two months of 1996.
